On October 23, 2026, Ms. Helen Nolan, Non-Executive Director of Dole plc (the “Company”), has informed the Company of her intention to retire from the Board on December 31, 2026, having served on the Board since 2021. The Company thanks Ms. Nolan for her valued contribution and dedicated service to the Board and wishes her well in the future.
